current.hook: Waiting for a sign to start?
current.question:
What would you
start today?
current.lesson:
Heaven never
takes a day off.
current.finding: SIX STRONG LINES. NO REST.
current.caption: The Creative is six unbroken lines: a start with nothing held back. It asks for no conditions, only that you mean it.

current.hook: Tired of always having to lead?
current.question:
Who could
you back?
current.lesson:
Lead and get lost.
Follow and arrive.
current.finding: SIX YIELDING LINES. ALL FOLLOW.
current.caption: The Receptive’s old image is a mare, strong and at her best when she follows well. Backing someone is its own strength.

current.question:
What needs
sorting first?
current.lesson:
Don't push yet.
Win helpers first.
current.finding: STRONG AT THE BASE, BELOW THE WEAK.
current.caption: The image is thunder with no rain yet, and the wise one sorts thread. When the rain comes, there’s something to weave.

current.hook: Asking again for a better answer?
current.question:
What’s your
real question?
current.lesson:
Teachers don't
chase students.
current.finding: THE YOUTH (5) SEEKS THE TEACHER (2).
current.caption: The image is a spring at the foot of a mountain. It doesn’t know where the sea is, and it moves on anyway.

current.question:
How can you
wait well today?
current.lesson:
In the rain?
Eat, rest, wait.
current.caption: The clouds are up and the rain hasn’t come, so the old text says: eat and drink. Waiting well takes energy.

current.hook: Fighting over something you’re right about?
current.meaning2:
Pushing to the end
costs you.
current.question:
What fight could
you leave now?
current.lesson:
Being right isn’t
reason to fight on.
current.finding:
AT THE TOP: THE BELT IS TAKEN.
WON BY FIGHTING, NO RESPECT.
current.caption: Heaven moves up and water moves down: both right, never meeting. The middle of a fight is the last good place to walk away.

current.hook: Leading a team through something hard?
current.question:
Who’s counting
on you?
current.lesson:
Lead upright,
the ranks fall in.
current.caption: The image is water under the earth, unseen but everywhere. An army is ordinary people, and they’re there when needed if you look after them.

current.question:
Who’s waiting
for your yes?
current.lesson:
Choose who you
stand beside
current.caption: The image is water on the earth, running to the low ground and filling it. People who need to belong come on their own; the ones who come late do badly.

current.question:
What can you
work on now?
current.lesson:
Don’t force a start.
Use the time to prepare.
current.finding:
AT THE BASE: HELD, IT RETURNS.
IT DOESN'T FORCE IT. NO BLAME.
current.caption: Dense clouds, no rain, and wind across the sky with nothing to hold. When the outside won’t move, the inside is the work.

current.hook: Working for someone with a temper?
current.meaning1:
Treading says:
mind how you step.
current.meaning2:
Stay steady and
it may pass.
current.question:
Who do you tread
carefully around?
current.lesson:
Near a temper,
stay steady inside.
current.finding:
LINE 2: A LEVEL PATH.
STEADY INSIDE, IT GOES WELL.
current.caption: The old text: you step on the tiger’s tail and it doesn’t bite. You are already in the danger, and how you conduct yourself keeps it asleep.

current.meaning2:
Peace is contact,
not a vacation.
current.question:
Who haven’t you
reached lately?
current.lesson:
High and low talk:
that is peace.
current.caption: The image is heaven and earth meeting. In good times the job isn’t to relax but to make sure the good reaches everyone.

current.hook: Everything stuck and no one’s talking?
current.question:
What will you
turn down?
current.lesson:
High and low part:
turn down rewards.
current.caption: Heaven and earth have stopped talking. When a system is broken, taking its rewards endorses it, so pull back.

current.question:
Who could you
invite in?
current.lesson:
Join on principle,
not on kinship.
current.finding: 2 AND 5 ANSWER, BOTH CENTRED.
current.caption: The old text puts fellowship out in the open, where anyone can walk up. Once you close the door and pick who’s in, you’ve left it.

current.hook: Doing better than everyone around you?
current.meaning2:
Use it to put
things right.
current.question:
What would you
fix first?
current.lesson:
Lead by trust,
not force.
current.finding: ONE YIELDING LINE. FIVE STRONG ANSWER.
current.caption: The image is fire high in the sky, lighting everything below. When you have a lot, people see what you do with it.

current.meaning2:
No one stops
the quiet ones.
current.question:
What could you
do without credit?
current.lesson:
Having the most,
step back.
current.caption: The image is a mountain inside the earth: the biggest thing around, and hidden. It’s the one hexagram where every line is favorable.

current.hook: All fired up, nowhere to go?
current.meaning1:
Enthusiasm says:
give it a shape.
current.question:
Where will you
aim it?
current.lesson:
One clear voice
moves the crowd.
current.finding: ONE STRONG LINE. FIVE FOLLOW IT.
current.caption: Thunder breaks out of the ground, and the first thing the old kings did with that energy was make music. Give it form, then direction.

current.hook: Still at your desk after dark?
current.meaning1:
Following says:
go with the day.
current.question:
When will you
stop today?
current.lesson:
To be followed,
follow first.
current.finding: THE STRONG GOES BELOW THE WEAK.
current.caption: The image is thunder resting inside the lake: at nightfall, you go indoors and rest. Following the day’s rhythm is what gives you tomorrow’s energy.

current.meaning1:
Decay says:
it can be fixed.
current.question:
What’s overdue
for repair?
current.lesson:
Found rot?
Clean it out.
current.caption: The judgment says three days before the turn and three days after: think on both sides of it. The repair works; the rush job doesn’t.

current.question:
What will you
prepare now?
current.lesson:
Lean down. Care
for your people.
current.caption: The judgment opens every door, then names a date: by the eighth month, trouble. Growth comes with the date it turns, so plan for it.

current.meaning2:
See by going,
not by sitting.
current.question:
What could you
go see?
current.lesson:
Look at your people.
They show how you lead.
current.finding:
LINE 5: LOOK AT YOUR OWN LIFE.
BY LOOKING AT YOUR PEOPLE.
current.caption: The image is wind moving over everything. The old kings traveled and looked before they taught.

current.question:
What will you
deal with now?
current.lesson:
Warn clearly,
then bite.
current.caption: Lightning, then thunder: first you see it, then you feel it. The old kings made the rules clear before they enforced them.

current.hook: Polishing the slides instead of deciding?
current.question:
What needs more
than polish?
current.lesson:
Plain is the best
adornment.
current.finding: AT THE TOP: PLAIN WHITE.
current.caption: Fire at the foot of the mountain is beautiful, but its light only reaches so far. Use grace for small things and substance for the hard ones.

current.meaning2:
Stay and help
those below you.
current.question:
Who depends
on you?
current.lesson:
Falling apart?
Shore up the base.
current.caption: The mountain sits on eroding earth, and the old text tells those on top to give to those below. The summit rests on the base.

current.hook: Coming back after a bad stretch?
current.question:
What are you
rushing back to?
current.lesson:
See your misstep,
turn back early.
current.caption: Thunder underground is energy returning before it shows, and the old kings stayed still to let it come. Only impatience stops a return.

current.question:
Where are you
performing?
current.lesson:
Do what's right,
not what pays.
current.finding: A STRONG LINE COMES IN AT THE BASE.
current.caption: The image is thunder under the sky, everything just being what it is. You don’t make things real; you stop making them fake.

current.hook: Years of practice, nobody’s seen it?
current.question:
What have you
been keeping in?
current.lesson:
Store up strength,
then use it.
current.finding: THE MOUNTAIN HOLDS HEAVEN IN.
current.caption: The image is heaven held inside a mountain. The old text says don’t eat at home: take what you’ve stored up out into the world.

current.hook: Said something you regret at dinner?
current.meaning2:
What goes in,
what comes out.
current.question:
Which do you
watch less?
current.lesson:
Guard your mouth:
food and words.
current.caption: Thunder under a mountain, and the advice is: careful with words, moderate with food. Both sound easy and trip up almost everyone.

current.question:
What’s bending
right now?
current.lesson:
The ends give way.
Brace them now.
current.caption: Water above the trees: the normal rules are off. It asks for one thing, the will to stand alone without making a fuss.

current.meaning2:
Like water: fill
it, flow on.
current.question:
What's the next
small step?
current.lesson:
Through danger,
keep your word.
current.caption: The I-Ching’s image here is water. It fills the hole it meets, then flows on.

current.question:
What needs
tending today?
current.lesson:
Like fire, cling
to what is right.
current.caption: Fire needs something to burn. The old text says to tend a cow: patient, dull, daily care. That’s what keeps the light going.

current.meaning2:
The full can’t
take anything in.
current.question:
What have you
already decided?
current.lesson:
Be moved as you
move others.
current.finding: ALL THREE PAIRS ANSWER.
current.caption: A lake sits on top of a mountain because the mountain made room. If you’re already certain, nothing can move you.

current.question:
What will you
keep doing?
current.lesson:
Change shape,
keep your course
current.caption: Thunder and wind never stop moving, and together they make duration. Stand firm: keep moving, but don’t change direction.

current.question:
What are you
ready to leave?
current.lesson:
Go while you still
can go freely.
current.finding: TWO YIELDING LINES CREEP UP.
current.caption: A mountain under heaven: heaven stays out of reach. Keep your distance from petty people, but without hate, because hate keeps you attached.

current.meaning1:
Great Power says:
check your aim.
current.meaning2:
Mostly, know what
not to do.
current.question:
What won’t you
do with it?
current.lesson:
Be strong only
in what is right.
current.finding: FOUR STRONG LINES PUSH UP.
current.caption: Thunder above heaven is the most force in the highest place, and the old text only says where not to walk. The power goes into staying off wrong paths.

current.question:
What are you
like up close?
current.lesson:
Shine,
don't push.
current.finding: THE SOFT RISES TO THE TOP CENTRE.
current.caption: The sun rises over the earth, and progress comes with the light. The text says brighten your character, not your strategy.

current.hook: Your good ideas getting shut down?
current.question:
What light are
you protecting?
current.lesson:
Dark times?
Dim your light.
current.caption: The light has sunk into the earth. In a dark time, dim the outside to keep the inside bright.

current.meaning1:
The Family says:
skip the rules.
current.meaning2:
Say real things.
Do them daily.
current.question:
What will you
follow through on?
current.lesson:
Order at home
starts with you.
current.finding:
AT THE TOP: TRUE, DIGNIFIED.
IT STARTS WITH YOUR CONDUCT.
current.caption: Wind born from fire: warmth makes the movement. A family whose words mean something and whose actions last doesn’t need the rules.

current.question:
What do you
both want?
current.lesson:
Lower your guard.
They may be an ally.
current.finding:
AT THE TOP: BOW LOWERED.
THE DOUBTS LIFT: NOT A FOE.
current.caption: Fire rises and water sinks; they’ll never meet. Fix small things first, and find what you share while staying different.

current.question:
Who could you
ask?
current.lesson:
Blocked?
Look at yourself.
current.finding:
LINES 2–5 IN POSITION.
STILL BLOCKED.
current.caption: Water on a mountain can’t flow. The old text says turn inward and find the great person: the obstacle tests whether you’ll ask.

current.question:
What can you
forgive?
current.lesson:
Out of danger?
Forgive, and move on.
current.finding:
LINE 5: THE NOBLE ONE LETS GO.
EVEN THE PETTY HOLD NO GRUDGE.
current.caption: Thunder and rain clear the air: if there’s work, do it now; if not, go home. Don’t carry grudges into the next round.

current.meaning1:
Decrease says:
give what you can.
current.meaning2:
Cut the anger,
cut the wants.
current.question:
What can you
let go of?
current.lesson:
Two small baskets
are enough.
current.finding: THE LOW LINE GIVES TO THE TOP.
current.caption: The old text asks for two small baskets, not a grand offering: when you have less, bring less. Anger and wanting cost the most.

current.question:
What will you
move toward?
current.lesson:
Let your gain
spill over
current.caption: Wind and thunder feed each other. The method of increase: see something good and move toward it.

current.question:
What needs
saying out loud?
current.lesson:
Remove the wrong
openly, unarmed.
current.caption: The rules in the text: announce it publicly, warn your own people first, and don’t use force. Fight darkness with a sword and you join it.

current.meaning1:
Coming to Meet
says: be wary.
current.question:
What’s too good
to be true?
current.lesson:
Check a bad start
while it's small.
current.caption: Wind under heaven reaches everywhere. When something slips in looking wonderful, don’t chase it; send your own message just as far.

current.question:
What holds your
group together?
current.lesson:
Gather people by
what is right.
current.finding: FOUR YIELDING LINES GATHER TO TWO.
current.caption: The king goes to the temple first: without a shared center, a gathering is just a crowd. And where people collect, friction follows.

current.question:
What can you add
today?
current.lesson:
Don’t rush the climb.
One step, then the next.
current.finding:
LINE 5: HE CLIMBS THE STAIRS.
STEADY, RIGHT, STEP BY STEP.
current.caption: A tree pushes up through the earth, going around the rock instead of jumping. It’s already growing, so stop braking.

current.question:
What’s worth
everything?
current.lesson:
Boxed in?
Hold to your aim.
current.caption: The image is a lake with no water: the container is there, the water is gone. The text says stake your life on your purpose.

current.question:
What do you help
keep running?
current.lesson:
Care for what
others depend on.
current.caption: The town changes; the well doesn’t, and the water is always there. What fails is a rope that’s too short or a bucket that breaks.

current.hook: Making a big change nobody believes in?
current.question:
What change are
you making?
current.lesson:
Go over the change
until it is trusted.
current.finding:
LINE 3: TALKED OVER THRICE.
SPOKEN TRUE, SO TRUSTED.
current.caption: Fire inside a lake, and the response is to set the calendar: name when one season ends and the next begins. People believe it once it’s done.

current.hook: Got the ingredients, not the result?
current.meaning1:
The Caldron says:
set it right.
current.meaning2:
Get set up
before you start.
current.question:
What’s out of
place right now?
current.lesson:
Set the pot firm,
then cook.
current.caption: Wood feeds the fire under the caldron, and it only works if it stands level. Tilted, it spills and the fire misses.

current.meaning1:
The Arousing says:
use the fear.
current.meaning2:
Let it show
what to fix.
current.question:
What did the
scare show you?
current.lesson:
When shaken,
examine yourself.
current.caption: The image is thunder, twice. You scream, then you laugh, and your hands still don’t drop the cup. A good scare is a chance to put things in order.

current.meaning2:
Stay with where
you are now.
current.question: What can wait?
current.lesson:
Stop when it's
time to stop.
current.finding: NO PAIR ANSWERS. EACH STANDS STILL.
current.caption: The old text says to keep your back still, so you stop chasing what’s in front of you.

current.meaning1:
Development says:
go step by step.
current.question:
Which step are
you skipping?
current.lesson:
Earn each place
before the next.
current.finding: LINES 2 TO 5 ALL IN THEIR PLACE.
current.caption: A tree on a mountain grows slowly where everyone can see it. Every shortcut here goes the wrong way.

current.meaning1:
Marrying Maiden
says: see the end.
current.question:
What does the
end look like?
current.lesson:
Wrong place?
Don't push.
current.finding: LINES 2 TO 5 ALL OUT OF PLACE.
current.caption: Thunder stirs the lake’s surface while the depths stay still. The text says to look past the middle to how it ends.

current.question:
What will you
decide now?
current.lesson:
At your fullest,
light each corner.
current.finding: THUNDER AND FIRE AT ONCE: FULL.
current.caption: The sun at noon is about to set, and the text still says don’t worry. Waste noon worrying about the afternoon and you never have a noon.

current.hook: Somewhere new, feeling out of place?
current.meaning1:
The Wanderer says:
keep it brief.
current.meaning2:
You’re a guest.
Act like one.
current.question:
Where are you
a guest?
current.lesson:
Far from home,
be a good guest
current.caption: Fire on a mountain is bright, seen, and moving on. The traveler gets small wins, so be clear, careful, brief.

current.meaning1:
The Gentle says:
say it again.
current.question:
What’s worth
repeating today?
current.lesson:
People change slowly.
Say it again, gently.
current.finding:
LINE 5: SAY IT, THEN AGAIN.
PEOPLE CAN'T CHANGE AT ONCE.
current.caption: The image is wind following wind. One gust changes nothing; a wind that keeps blowing reshapes the land. Say the important thing more than once.

current.hook: Good news, no one to tell?
current.question:
Who could you
call today?
current.lesson:
Laugh and learn
with friends.
current.caption: The Joyous is two lakes that keep each other full. Joy kept to yourself dries up.

current.meaning2:
Remind them where
they come from.
current.question:
What do you
all share?
current.lesson:
Bring them back
to the centre.
current.finding: WIND MOVES OVER WATER.
current.caption: Wind over water scatters the surface, and the old kings built temples. A shared center pulls people back; force only wears you out.

current.question:
Where’s your
limit?
current.lesson:
Set limits
you can keep.
current.finding:
LINE 5: A SWEET LIMIT.
IT KEEPS TO THE MIDDLE.
current.caption: A lake holds only so much water, and that’s what makes it a lake. Limits work; harsh limits break.

current.meaning2:
Hold off judging
until you do.
current.question:
What haven’t you
asked them yet?
current.lesson:
No hidden motive;
mean what you say.
current.caption: The old text says inner truth reaches even pigs and fishes. The way in is to understand someone before you judge them.

current.meaning1:
The Small says:
no big moves.
current.question:
What small thing
can you do?
current.lesson:
Fly low.
Do small things.
current.caption: The bird’s call comes from below: descend, don’t climb. The text allows one excess only: more humble, more careful, more frugal.

current.question:
What could
go wrong?
current.lesson:
Done? Now guard
against trouble.
current.caption: Water over fire, in balance for now, and the text warns: good start, messy end. Think about what can go wrong while it still works.

current.meaning2:
Sort things out
before you move.
current.question:
What goes
where?
current.lesson:
Almost done?
Stay careful to the end.
current.finding:
AT THE TOP: HE WETS HIS HEAD.
NO RESTRAINT AT THE END.
current.caption: The book’s last hexagram is a little fox that gets its tail wet just before the far bank. Sixty-four hexagrams, and the last word is: not yet.
